candidates.title: Amazon SageMaker Inference: 2026 year-to-date launches in review
candidates.summary: Amazon SageMaker AI shipped 13 inference launches in year-to-date across two deployment paths: fully managed endpoints and Amazon SageMaker HyperPod Inference. This post reviews each launch, from inference recommendations and capacity-aware instance pools to tiered KV caching and disaggregated prefill and decode.

candidates.title: Petlibro’s new AI-powered feeder is a game changer for multi-cat homes
candidates.summary: Petlibro's new Granary 2 smart feeders use a built-in scale and (on pricier models) an AI camera to track exactly how much your cat is eating and when — though the fanciest health-monitoring features will cost you an extra subscription.

candidates.title: Introducing Kimi K3 on Amazon Bedrock
candidates.summary: Kimi K3 from Moonshot AI is now available on Amazon Bedrock, giving you a powerful new open-weight option for coding and knowledge work. It offers native vision, a 1-million-token context window, and explicit prompt caching to reduce latency and input costs.
